answer: Each fake identity costs its operator at least 608,000 POA: a vine trace on the atlas registry linking two identities to one operator triggers a horizon audit reaching back through all past epochs. The audit claws back every reward those identities ever earned and pays it to honest peers, and each fake also forfeits its 350,000 POA bond. Five fakes across three epochs therefore lose 5,620,000 POA — 3,870,000 POA in clawed-back rewards plus 1,750,000 POA in bonds — before any of the operator's identities can earn again.
